newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares tread water in mid-session bourse.
newsitem.headline: German shares tread water in mid-session bourse.

text.p: Germany's DAX share index on Friday was practically unchanged from its closing position the previous day in bourse trade, boosted by interest from German domestic fund managers and strongly performing Bunds.
Mid-session the DAX-30 index of German blue-chip shares stood at 2,851.47 points, up 2.70 points. Dealers said that the strength of German bonds were underpinning equities.

"The German market seems to be in better shape than other markets. There seems to be German domestic funds committing cash -- they have been light on equities so far and now they seem to be putting some money in," said one trader.

German shares made a strong recovery in early trade. Shares on Thursday were hit by the initially weak performance of U.S. equities, but a late U.S. rally gave German shares a much-needed early boost.
The main data of the morning was German November industrial output data, which rose 1.6 percent month-on-month, compared to a fall of 0.7 percent in October.

The DAX index seemed underwhelmed by the data and did not move appreciably up or down. "People weren't watching the output data. The market doesn't seem to be concentrating on the macroeconomic data," a trader said. "Everyone seems much more interested in looking at Bunds -- they are really underpinning the market," he added.

Many market players were still enjoying the last days of their Christmas holidays. Dealers said that Monday would be the first meaningful day for the German share market, but that low volumes could lead to market volatility.
The main volumes of trade were spread across different sectors. Commerzbank AG was higher among the banks, up 75 pfennigs at 39.50 marks,
There was also strong interest in the chemical sector, which suffered after the dollar fell sharply on Thursday.
BASF AG and Hoechst AG were both higher, up 33 pfennigs at 58.35 marks and 54 pfennigs at 70.62 marks respectively, while Bayer AG was up ten pfennigs at 61.87 marks.
